name_zh: 同时间自映射偏差消除
structural_signature: Pointwise deterministic self-map quotient, no covariance estimate, transport or temporal regularizer.

name_zh: 保留动作特征的几何近端更新
structural_signature: Deterministic equality-constrained repair in output trajectory space.

name_zh: 相关参考误差的矩阵校正
structural_signature: Statistical matrix estimator learned from error cross-moments, with explicit estimation penalty.

name_zh: 不确定动作约束下的稳健修复
structural_signature: Robust inequality-constrained repair, distinct from an exact nullspace projection.

name_zh: 保留对应多解的空间联合分支
structural_signature: Discrete spatial mode assignment before deformation, as opposed to continuous averaging or mass balancing.

name_zh: 面积边际约束的对应运输
structural_signature: Continuous globally mass-balanced correspondence coupling.

name_zh: 允许不匹配质量的部分运输
structural_signature: Mass rejection with complete-output fallback.

name_zh: 端点约束的轨迹分布桥
structural_signature: Path-distribution KL projection with two endpoint marginals.

name_zh: 局部旋转的图同步
structural_signature: SO(3) graph-gauge synchronization, not coordinate smoothing.

name_zh: 形变梯度的可积投影
structural_signature: Pinned weighted range projection of a differential field.

name_zh: 保留旋转的应变约束修复
structural_signature: Nonlinear polar-coordinate stretch projection followed by reconstruction.

name_zh: 最大可行的三角面安全修正
structural_signature: Exact line-feasibility root calculation on triangle geometry.

name_zh: 稀疏加速度的事件保留修复
structural_signature: Nonsmooth group acceleration sparsity rather than quadratic smoothing or low-rank estimation.

name_zh: 共转坐标中的时间修复
structural_signature: Time filtering after factoring pose, not spatial rotation synchronization.

name_zh: 保护动作分量的低秩轨迹修复
structural_signature: Protected-component nuclear-norm trajectory estimator.

name_zh: 参考帧的误差传播选择
structural_signature: Finite anchor-design decision using a propagated error/cost model.

name_zh: 曲率误差驱动的查询预算
structural_signature: Continuous curvature/error budget allocation for decoder interpolation.

name_zh: 消去相机干扰的形变优化
structural_signature: Weighted elimination of a nuisance parameter block.

name_zh: 输出度量中的双路引导
structural_signature: Reachable output-metric least squares over two latent guidance columns.

name_zh: 相位与动作幅度的可识别分解
structural_signature: Endpoint-preserving monotone phase/amplitude block inference.
